rule: Carried unchanged to both systems; the join key for reconciliation
Generated by EC on hire; returned to ServiceNow by the HR integration
EC is master after hire; Fieldglass name used only to create
Assigned by IAM at provisioning and written back to EC; supplier email is never used for login
Drives which onboarding lifecycle event ServiceNow starts
Onboarding case must be opened at least 10 business days before
A Fieldglass revision that extends the work order must update EC the same day
Manager must be an active employee in EC
Validated against the EC cost-centre list before the work order is approved
Free text in Fieldglass mapped to an EC job code where one exists
Site codes mapped through a lookup table
Needed for supplier-level onboarding and access reviews
Commercial data stays in Fieldglass; HR and IT don't need it
Termination in EC triggers the offboarding case and account disable in ServiceNow
